verdict.rationale: Sardine is a fraud and compliance platform, and on-prem or self-hosted deployment is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only describes hosted access: you request a sandbox dashboard account, then integrate through APIs and a proprietary SDK. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-prem or open-source deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
